Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Ops & Architecture sync — next steps and scheduling

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for the great call today. High level recap: CarePath is evaluating a hosted + VPC pattern for inference, your primary concerns are token-level cost predictability, audit logs for PHI access, and an architecture pattern that keeps inference latency under 120ms for 512-token responses.

Proposed next step: a focused ops & architecture session where we walk system architects through:
- current infra footprint & traffic patterns (you)
- Redwood inference runtime topology options (our side)
- KV/prefix caching strategies and expected cost/latency tradeoffs
- audit logging and KMS integration checklist

I have two 60-min slots that work for our engineering leads:
- Wed Mar 25, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu Mar 26, 13:00–14:00 PT

Please let me know which works (or propose alternatives). Also confirm the CarePath attendees we should expect (networking, security, platform engineering). I attached a one-page mutual action plan and a simple network diagram for reference.

If you prefer Google Meet vs Zoom, tell me and I’ll send the calendar invite with the right link.

Thanks,
Karthik

--

Karthik —

Appreciate the recap and the attachments. Wed Mar 25 10:00 PT works for us (that’s Thu 18:00 here). Attendees I’ll confirm but plan to include:
- Liam O'Neill (Head of Product)
- Sofia Chen (Platform Eng)
- Aaron Patel (SRE) — I CC'd the team alias will loop him in if needed

Focus please on: 1) how Redwood handles KV cache warmup/TTL when we scale instances; 2) KMS/HSM key lifecycle & audit trails; 3) autoscaling behaviors under burst traffic.

Google Meet is fine. Please send a calendar invite with the agenda and a Meet link. Also can you include an itemized list of what logs are exported by default vs via opt-in? That will help our security team.

I’ll be on the call from our Dublin office.

Thanks,
Liam
